item.title: Version 3.0.13
item.description:
✨ New Onboarding Experience

  • Interactive Video Walkthrough – New users are now guided through a 4-step onboarding flow with embedded video demos
  • Seamless Integration – Onboarding appears as an elegant overlay within the dashboard, not a separate window
  • Smooth Transitions – Crossfade animations between steps for a polished experience

🎨 Design Refinements

  • Minimal, glassmorphic UI matching the app's design language
  • Time-of-day adaptive styling throughout onboarding
  • Progress indicator aligned with step navigation

🔧 Under the Hood

  • Optimized video playback with AVPlayerLayer (no visible controls)
  • Improved resource bundling for embedded assets
